title: An order-preserving map constant on $\{i,i+1\}$ factors through $\sigma_i$
statement: Let $\Delta$ be the category of the ordered sets $[m]=\{0<1<\dots<m\}$ and order-preserving maps [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], and for $k\geq1$ and $0\leq i\leq k-1$ let $\sigma^{k-1}_i:[k]\to[k-1]$ be the order-preserving surjection repeating $i$, i.e. $\sigma^{k-1}_i(x)=x$ for $x\leq i$ and $\sigma^{k-1}_i(x)=x-1$ for $x>i$. Let $k\geq1$, $n\geq0$, let $\varphi:[k]\to[n]$ be order-preserving and let $0\leq i\leq k-1$ with $\varphi(i)=\varphi(i+1)$. Then there is an order-preserving map $\psi:[k-1]\to[n]$ with $\varphi=\psi\circ\sigma^{k-1}_i$.
